## About
Zam Zam Auto Sales & Repairs is a car repair and maintenance shop on W Northgate Dr in Irving, Texas. We also sell cars, so you can come to us whether you need work done on the car you drive or are looking for your next one.
We're open Monday through Saturday and closed on Sunday. Come see us and we'll talk through what your car needs.

## Services
- Car repair and maintenance: Repair and routine maintenance work for your car at our Irving shop.
- Auto sales: We sell cars as well as fix them. Stop by to ask what we have on the lot.
